{{Quote|But that was before, old friend. And it was before Dusty.''"<br />"''Would it help if I said I was sorry about her?''"<br />"''Wouldn't hurt. But it wouldn't help any, either. She did what she did because she did it.|Baasen Ray and Han Solo|<ref name="Honor Among Thieves" />}}
'''Dusty''' was an individual. An incident involving her was a cause of the grudge between [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Baasen Ray]]. Later, when Solo and Ray meet again, Solo offered to apologize for what happened, but Ray felt it would not help.<ref name="Honor Among Thieves" />
